audits.text:
## 9e0cd377fa63

**Reproduced generator shortcut; no fix made.** Generator SHA-256
`5e99608a960de39a1b357a127e04b6a72db357ff8c1cb2b557f64062148c5b0e`
emits marker pairs only at the northwest and southeast corners of each target
rectangle. It therefore never demonstrates the northeast–southwest diagonal.
A plausible rival is **expand only positive-slope (NW–SE) marker pairs into
rectangle perimeters**.

I constructed a default-domain 10×10 input containing two separated 3×3
rectangles whose same-colour markers are on the NE–SW diagonal. The target
`self_check` returns no errors. The selected Racket rule hash
`ecacd159b916` fills both perimeters; the rival leaves the input unchanged at
12 cells where Racket paints colour 4 or 7. The exact input, Racket output,
rival output, differing cells, generator/rule hashes, command, and domain note
are retained in `checks/audit/9e0cd377fa63/counterexample.json`; supported apply
evidence is in `checks/audit/9e0cd377fa63/racket.json`.

This demonstrates a distribution omission and a concrete shortcut, not an
authority error. I left the audit target unchanged as required. The first apply
attempt failed preflight because its evidence file had not yet been written;
that failed attempt is retained in the packet-root audit log, and the successful
supported apply is the evidence cited above.

triage.reason: Accepted as reviewer-reported, source-bound findings: 9e0cd377fa63 omits NE-SW corner-pair coverage and its submitted lawful witness exposes an authority mismatch; 40f6e5fa30e1 ignores exact count controls.
